question: What is the meaning of insurance documents of object and leasing contracts of sub-componentes in relation to official declarations (agency or contractor provided, mostly during the life cycle)?
data_group: official declarations (agency or contractor provided, mostly during the life cycle)
data_point: insurance documents of object and leasing contracts of sub-componentes
description: Insurance documents of object and leasing contracts of sub-components in relation to official declarations during the life cycle typically refer to the legal and financial aspects associated with ensuring the protection and maintenance of the structure or asset. This includes providing coverage for potential damages, liabilities, or risks that may arise during the useful life of the structure. Additionally, leasing contracts for sub-components involve agreements between parties for the temporary ownership or use of specific parts or materials within the construction project, outlining responsibilities, terms, and conditions for their utilization. These documents play a crucial role in establishing accountability, transparency, and compliance with regulations throughout the life cycle of the structure.

If we zoom in on the information that the stakeholder needs to

Client 
● Management of the assets: materials and the corresponding raw

● Value of assets quantified: materials, raw materials, types of

● Tracing the owner of leased products.

physics aspects.

customisation, disassembly plan.

construction elements’ loads, residual service life, design 
principles, building physics aspects. 
● Reuse: design principles including changes, transportation 
possibilities, materials, standard parts linked to serial numbers
